a: Vitamins are organic compounds needed in small amounts for health.
Minerals like iron and calcium support many body functions.
Protein builds and repairs tissues and makes enzymes.
Carbohydrates are a primary energy source for the body.
Fats support energy storage, hormones, and cell membranes.
Dietary fiber supports digestion and is found in plants.
Excess added sugar is linked to health risks; moderation helps.
High sodium intake can raise blood pressure in many people.
Online health info cannot diagnose; see a clinician for symptoms.
For emergencies, contact local emergency services immediately.
